problem: A quadratic equation with real coefficients has a root $x=\frac{-2+7\text{i}}{2}.$ What is the other root?
worked_solution: We're given that the quadratic equation has real coefficients and that $x=\frac{-2+7\text{i}}{2}=-1+\frac{7}{2}\text{i}$ is a root. Therefore, its complex conjugate $x=-1-\frac{7}{2}\text{i}=\frac{-2-7\text{i}}{2}$ is also a root.
